notes: Is update me ek zaroori bug fix hai: sports ki khabron par ab sahi category 'Sports' (Hindi me 'खेल') dikhegi — pehle kuch khabron par galti se 'Others' dikh raha tha aur Sports tab khali reh jata tha. Ab saari sports khabrein apni sahi jagah par dikhengi. Saath me app ke andar pehle se rakhi taazi khabron ka packet bhi update kar diya gaya hai.
